title: S7 Audio. Calls by several narwhals in close proximity (Blackwell et al. 2018, Spatial and temporal patterns of sound production in East Greenland narwhals, PLOS ONE)
author: Susanna B. Blackwell, Outi M. Tervo, Alexander S. Conrad, Mikkel H. S. Sinding, Rikke G. Hansen, Susanne Ditlevsen, Mads Peter Heide-Jørgensen
changes: Narwhals (Monodon monoceros) calling in Scoresby Sound, East Greenland, recorded by an Acousonde tag on a narwhal: a tonal call followed by a pulsed call. Trimmed to 0.45–3.15 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Supplementary audio of an open-access PLOS ONE article. No high-pass: the tag recording has no energy below about 1 kHz.
